title: GTA 6 Launch Night on Kick.com: Hourly Viewers
subtitle: 22 hourly snapshots: 7,905 to 1,353,198 concurrent viewers in 15 hours

resources.description: The headline series: GTA 6 concurrent viewers and category rank per hourly snapshot, with Just Chatting, IRL, GTA V and Slots alongside for scale.
Every live GTA 6 stream in every snapshot: 17,763 rows across 4,141 channels and 51 languages, with concurrent viewers, title, language and start time.
Every ranked Kick.com category in every snapshot (89 distinct categories), so GTA 6's rise can be read against the rest of the platform.
